post.summary: Log in

get.summary: Whether the database has zero users yet (public)

post.summary: Bootstrap-only: creates the first Admin on an empty database, 403s otherwise

patch.summary: Self-service password change. Requires currentPassword + newPassword (min 8 chars); 401 if currentPassword is wrong.

post.summary: Create a user (Admin: any role/campaigns; Supervisor: Agent-only, campaigns within own scope)

delete.summary: Deactivate a user (Admin: anyone; Supervisor: own-scope Agents only)

patch.summary: Set a user's monthly base salary in PKR, used by payroll generation (Admin)

Admin/Supervisor-mediated forgot-password: generates a temp password (returned once, in the response), flags the account must_change_password. Admin: anyone but self; Supervisor: own-scope Agents only.
Admin only: change any other user's role (Admin | Supervisor | Agent). Takes effect on that user's very next request. An Admin cannot change their own role.

post.summary: Create campaign (Admin)

patch.summary: Update campaign details and reassign agents (Admin: any campaign, any agent; Supervisor: only a campaign they already have access to, and only agents they themselves share campaign access with -- assignedAgentIds only ever contains Agent-role users, never a Supervisor's own management-access row)

get.summary: List sales (optional ?campaignId filter). Each sale includes full utility-order fields: address/apt/city/state/zipCode, phone2, supplierName, electric/gas utility+account+rate fields, confirmationNumber, and a raw saleDateIso for client-side date-range filtering.

post.summary: Submit a sale/order (Agent). Required: campaignId, customerName, phone, amount. Accepts the full order-detail field set plus an optional saleDate.
Clock in
Clock out

get.summary: List targets. Admin: everyone. Supervisor: only agents who share one of their own campaigns. Agent: only their own.

patch.summary: Admin: any target field, for any agent. Supervisor: only monthlySalesTarget (a whole number of sales), and only for agents sharing one of their campaigns.

post.summary: Schedule callback
Create lead

Generate/refresh payroll for a month (Admin). Body: { month: 'YYYY-MM' }. Computes base salary + commission (approved sales amount x campaign commission_rate) per active agent; preserves existing bonus/deductions on regeneration.

get.summary: Admin only: salary advances with recovered/outstanding balances

post.summary: Admin only: record a salary advance { agentId, amountPkr, givenOn?, note? }. Outstanding advances are deducted automatically when payroll is calculated.

delete.summary: Admin only: delete an advance. 409 once any part has been recovered from a paid payroll.

post.summary: Any signed-in user with access to the campaign: is this phone number on the campaign's Do-Not-Call list? Body { campaignId, phone }. Returns only { found, campaignId, campaignName }. Rate limited.

get.summary: Admin/Supervisor: DNC entry count per campaign (Supervisor: own campaigns only)

Admin/Supervisor: page through a campaign's DNC entries (?campaignId&q&limit&offset). q matches the number however it is written -- digits are compared against the normalised key -- and also matches the other columns kept from the sheet (name, city, reference) and the note.

post.summary: Admin/Supervisor: add one number to a campaign's DNC list { campaignId, phone, note? }

delete.summary: Admin/Supervisor: remove every number on a campaign's DNC list (?campaignId). The single most destructive DNC call -- irreversible, and its own explicit action rather than a side effect of anything else.

post.summary: Admin/Supervisor: import one chunk of numbers into a campaign's master list -- { campaignId, rows: [{ phone, note?, fields? }] } (or the older { numbers: [] }), max 20,000 per request. Uploads merge, never overwrite: a number already listed stays a single row and only gains details it was missing. Returns added / duplicates / enriched / invalid counts.

Admin/Supervisor: delete a chosen set of entries in one request { campaignId, ids: [] }, max 20,000 ids. Scoped to campaignId on the query itself, so an id from a different campaign is simply not matched, never deleted. Returns { deleted }.

put.summary: Admin/Supervisor: edit an entry { phone, note? }. Refused with 409 if the new number is already on the same campaign's list.

delete.summary: Admin/Supervisor: remove a number from a DNC list

get.summary: Admin only: IP allowlist state { enabled, yourIp, yourIpAllowed, overrideActive, entries[] }

post.summary: Admin only: allow an IPv4/IPv6 address or CIDR range { cidr, label? }

delete.summary: Admin only: remove an allowed address. 409 if it would block the acting Admin while enforcement is on.

put.summary: Admin only: switch the portal IP restriction on/off { enabled }. 409 when turning on would lock the acting Admin out.

patch.summary: Adjust bonus/deductions on a payroll record and recompute net salary (Admin)

get.summary: List/poll messages. ?channel= scopes to one group or DM thread (403 if you're not a member/participant); omitted, returns every message across every group you belong to plus your own DM threads.

post.summary: Send a message. For a group channel you must be a member (403 otherwise). For a DM channel (id starts with 'dm:'), also pass recipientId; the server recomputes the expected channel id and rejects a mismatch.

get.summary: List message groups. Default: only groups you belong to. ?all=true (Admin only): every group in the system, for management.

post.summary: Create a message group (Admin: any members; Supervisor: self + Agents within own campaign scope). Body: { id, name, memberIds }

patch.summary: Replace a group's membership (Admin: any; Supervisor: must be a member themselves, can only add Agents within own campaign scope)

post.summary: Admin/Supervisor: add a document { title, content, category?, summary? }

patch.summary: Admin/Supervisor: edit a document (title, category, summary, content)

post.summary: Create support ticket
Wipe all business data, keeping schema intact (Admin)
